description: Price out emptying a chain's native gas balance to exactly zero: how much actually arrives, the full fee breakdown, and whether the balance is even large enough to be worth recovering. Call this before sweeping so the user sees the numbers first. Returns a quote ID; quotes expire after about 60 seconds.

destination.description: Destination address to receive swept funds

fromChainId.description: Source chain ID to sweep from

toChainId.description: Destination chain ID to receive funds

userAddress.description: User's wallet address to sweep from

name: zerodust_get_quote
